xwikidoc.content:
Example:
##{{{{{kanbanboard space="TaskManager" /}}}}}##
* ##user## [optional, default=$xcontext.userReference] define the user for who tasks are assigned * ##space## [optional, default=TaskManager] define the space to look for tasks * ##project## [optional, default=] define the project to look for tasks * ##colors## [optional, default=green,blue,orange] define the colors of the Kanban columns * ##columns## [optional, default=ToDo,InProgress,Done] define the statuses to display as Kanban columns * ##columnWidth## [optional, default=32%] define the width of all Kanban column
Example:
{{kanbanboard selection="space" space="TaskManager"/}}

{{velocity}} #set($discard = $xwiki.ssx.use('TaskManager.KanbanBoardMacro')) ## The xwql variable is used by the awmkanban macro called from this one. It starts with the constraint shared by all ## the task queries. Note that awmkanban doesn't apply the 'hidden' query filter, so inline tasks are displayed. #set ($xwql = $taskQueryBaseConstraint) #set($user = "$!{xcontext.macro.params.user}") #set ($columnWidth = "$!{xcontext.macro.params.columnWidth}") #set ($colors = "$!{xcontext.macro.params.colors}") #if($user != '') #set ($xwqlUsers = '') #set ($users = $user.split(',')) #foreach ($user in $users) #if ($xwqlUsers.length() > 0) #set ($xwqlUsers = "$xwqlUsers OR") #end ## The task contains at least one of the specified users. #set ($xwqlUsers = "$xwqlUsers obj.assignee LIKE '%$escapetool.sql($user),%' OR obj.assignee LIKE '%$escapetool.sql($user)'") #end #set ($xwql = "$xwql and ($xwqlUsers)") #end #set($space = "$!{xcontext.macro.params.space}") #if($space != '') #set($xwql = "${xwql} and (doc.space like '$escapetool.sql($space).%' or doc.space = '$escapetool.sql($space)')") #end #set($project = "$!{xcontext.macro.params.project}") #if($project != '') #set ($xwqlProjects = '') #set ($projects = $project.split(',')) #foreach ($project in $projects) #if ($xwqlProjects.length() > 0) #set ($xwqlProjects = "$xwqlProjects OR") #end #set ($xwqlProjects = "$xwqlProjects obj.project = '$escapetool.sql($project)'") #end #set ($xwql = "$xwql and ($xwqlProjects)") #end #set ($columns = "$!{xcontext.macro.params.columns}") #set ($order = "$!{xcontext.macro.params.order}") #set ($limit = "$!{xcontext.macro.params.limit}") {{awmkanban className="TaskManager.TaskManagerClass" category="status" displayedCategoryColumns="$!escapetool.xml($columns)" title="name" columns="assignee,progress,duedate" width="$!escapetool.xml($columnWidth)" colors="$!escapetool.xml($colors)" order="$!escapetool.xml($order)" limit="$!escapetool.xml($limit)" /}} {{/velocity}}

property.description: Display the tasks as a Kanban board (see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kanban_board).
When value ##user## is defined in ##selection## parameter, this parameter defines which user has to be selected. The default user is the current one.
When value ##space## is defined in ##selection## parameter, this parameter defines in which space the tasks has to be taken. The default space is ##TaskManager##.
When value ##project## is defined in ##selection## parameter, this parameter defines in which project the tasks has to be taken. There is no default value.
This parameter defines the columns and the order of the columns to display based on possible status (ToDo, InProgress and Done by default).
The width of each Kanban column, specified in any css units (example: 32%, 500px, 30em, etc..).
